svg.title: GitHub delivery to worker termination
svg.desc: Detailed execution call cards in reading order. Each card shows inputs, transformations and persistence. Dashed cards are assumed connections. Branches and alternatives are explicitly labeled. Read the linked Markdown for all field contracts and errors.
svg.text: White outline = implemented function / AWS configuration • Dashed orange = assumed adapter
Read numbered cards in order; follow the explicit branch labels. Full field and failure contracts are in README.md.

g.text: 1 HTTP invocation: handler → handleGitHub
IN method, path, headers, original body bytes
ADD requestId in log context; verify HMAC before JSON
OUT validated event → normalized webhook
STORE logs only; full webhook stays out of DynamoDB
2 Command → trackedRequest → DynamoService.create
IN body starts with @agent or /agent; delivery header
ADD receivedAt; project nine request fields
OUT conditional PutItem accepted
STORE request under deliveryId; duplicates fail
3 Register timeout, then publish provision event
CALL SchedulerService.scheduleTimeout(request)
CALL EventBridgeService.putEvent(..., request)
ADD schedule UUID, at(now + 30 min), event metadata
STORE Scheduler input; DynamoDB request unchanged
4 EventBridge → POST /provision → launch adapter
IN complete envelope; connection adds X-Api-Key
ASSUMED parse detail; read original stored request
ADD timeoutAt = stored receivedAt + 30 minutes
CALL await EC2Service.createInstance(options)
5 Journal reservation → RunInstances → record
IN deliveryId, timeoutAt, fixed config, shared group
ADD SHA-256 client token; AWS allocates instance ID
STORE resourceLaunch {deliveryId, token, instanceId}
STORE four tags on instance, volume and interface
6 EC2 boots the AMI; no worker job code is supplied
IN Ubuntu ARM64 AMI, m8g.xlarge, 50 GiB gp3
NO UserData, checkout, agent runner or completion API
OUT AWS state may become running → active view
STORE lifecycle views are not saved in DynamoDB
7 Timeout adapter OR independent recurring cleanup
ASSUMED /timeout → deleteInstance(detail.deliveryId)
REAL /cleanup → cleanupExpiredInstances → recheck
CALL TerminateInstances using journal or expired tags
OUT termination_requested; tracking errors separate
8 AWS completes termination asynchronously
AWS shutting-down → terminated; root deletion enabled
NO waiter, terminal-state write or request deletion
RETAIN request, launch token and instance ID
RETAIN shared group, buses, secrets and recurring schedule
